g.text: Entry timing changes both return and drawdown
Same saved daily filters, exits and sizes on October 18–20, 2026. Only the entry wait changes.
Wait after the first minute completes (seconds)
Dashed line: original 60-second wait after the completed first minute. Points are separate modeled portfolios.
The curves reuse previously examined dates; choosing their best point would use evaluation outcomes.
One position, one trade per contract, prior-volume limits and estimated fees. These are not measured executable fills.
